response.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.derived_total_cost / ili.derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: derived_product_cost is never zero, to avoid division by zero errors

alternatives.interpretation: The 'average ratio' could mean the ratio of aggregate totals—sum of all derived_total_cost divided by sum of all derived_product_cost per invoice—rather than the average of individual line-item ratios
alternatives.sql: SELECT i.invoice_number, SUM(ili.derived_total_cost) / SUM(ili.derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;
